agreements: The narrow organism remains worth preserving: public-only projection, immutable witnessed rows, audit-only proposals, one fallible blind model SELF_CHECK, deterministic recurrent construction, target-absent THINK0, matched OWN/DIST return branches, fresh atomic THINK1, prospective reader interventions, conditional two-adapter transport, and monotone reviewed authority form a coherent engineering-canary skeleton.

DREAM and SELF_CHECK are model calls rather than truth verifiers; model-SUPPORTED rows may be false, and generated prose, confidence, prediction, audit state, private truth, answers, and results must never become later cognitive or training inputs.

The final goal may be sealed host-side before heldout dispatch while remaining absent from cognition until its registered reveal, and path/sham plans must seal after reveal but before any T-arm output or scoring.

The text-stage conjunction is appropriately stronger than T-OWN success alone: it requires target-absent return requests, M0/DIST loss, an OWN-only correct focus row, offline-correct nondecoratively used role and causal roots, donor-valid twin behavior, path loss, sham retention, accounting, and review.

The LoRA stage, if eventually valid, can support only immediate candidate-constrained recognition for registered cues and own/donor decision paths of two isolated adapters; it cannot establish open recall, whole-corpus preservation, text equivalence, durability, capacity, scale, or superiority.

The aligned seed-5 pair, explicit source-target probe, game-specific DREAM ontology, and proof-sequence THINK1 scaffold make every positive or negative result an engineering-ceiling diagnostic rather than evidence for the frozen Paper-1 headline.

Review identity and fresh-context receipts are platform-attested operational separation controls, not cryptographic or substantive proof of independence; reviewer supremacy, changed-byte rereview, and the unconditional human terminal remain mandatory.

The exact v1c bytes are not a single executable protocol: jointly normative files contradict one another and required schemas reject required data. Hash binding preserves those defects and cannot authorize an implementation to choose among them.

No consensus, reviewer, advocate, or human decision over these v1c bytes may bypass the rework findings. A repaired successor must be newly hash-bound and deliberated, and any later ratification may release CPU implementation only, never model, GPU, fit, or claim authority.

disagreements.issue: Whether joint hashes and local schemas are sufficient to form one executable protocol despite cross-file semantic contradictions.

positions.position: The v1c package presents its jointly normative files, resolved executable lock, golden vectors, and P1CB01/P1CB09 as enough to make the finite stage graph unique.

Hash equality only binds the conflicting bytes; without one canonical cross-contract consistency inventory and repaired schemas, implementation would have to select outcome-relevant semantics forbidden by experiment_spec.md.

resolution.rationale: The second position is compelled by the normative precedence rule. The confirmed DEV-domain, citation-order, sham-routing, ledger, roster-binding, and schema-overlap conflicts make P1CB01 impossible to pass honestly.
resolution.selected_position: Require a newly hash-bound successor that is internally consistent before any ratification or implementation.
resolution.required_change: Successor requirement: publish one exhaustive cross-contract semantic-consistency matrix naming every normative producer, consumer, object, ordering, validity, and ledger encoding; make every v1c file and schema conform to it; reject any unlisted or contradictory case as PROTOCOL_CONTRADICTION. P1CB01 must verify the complete matrix and P1CB09 must verify every runtime mapping; neither test may choose semantics.

disagreements.issue: Whether the proposed noninterference test explicitly excludes host-side laundering of the withheld goal or a cue-specific answer roster before authorized reveal.

positions.position: The broad private/audit/donor mutation language and visibility matrix are sufficient to cover forbidden host dependencies.
The decisive final-goal coordinate/question mutations and cross-cue roster substitutions are not explicit, so a passing implementation could still use an answer-agenda channel.

resolution.rationale: The host seals answer-relevant goal coordinates and answer-bearing candidate rosters; these exact mutation classes must be named rather than inferred from generic taint language.
resolution.selected_position: Add explicit goal-byte and cue-roster noninterference vectors.
resolution.required_change: Successor requirement: P1CB02 must independently mutate each host-only final-goal coordinate, the rendered final question, and a roster selected from every other concrete cue instance while holding public pre-reveal inputs fixed; it must byte-compare every pre-reveal rendered/tokenized request, selector, proposal/row, compiler view, candidate registry binding, corpus, training example, and read projection, excluding only registered causal descendants after authorized reveal.

disagreements.issue: Whether accepted citations have one canonical order and required witnessed SOURCE_VALUE/ANIMAL_VALUE rows validate exactly one schema branch.

positions.position: Accepted citations preserve emitted proposal-premise order followed by model-identified support rows in supplied additional-row order, with defensive first-occurrence deduplication.
Accepted citations are the ASCII-byte-sorted unique union; dream_state additionally encodes identical SOURCE_VALUE and ANIMAL_VALUE field branches inside oneOf.

resolution.rationale: The orderings change record hashes, visible citations, lineage traversal, and selector ties. The identical oneOf branches reject every required SOURCE_VALUE and ANIMAL_VALUE witnessed row. A successor must choose one order; preserving model and supplied-row order best matches the prompts, but only newly ratified bytes can enact it.
resolution.selected_position: Use premise order followed by supplied support-row order and make row alternatives discriminated by kind rather than identical field shapes.
resolution.required_change: Successor requirement: every reducer/transport/schema file must define accepted citations as proposal premise_ids in emitted order followed by support_row_ids in their supplied additional_rows order, first-occurrence deduplicated; bind interleaved-premise/support golden vectors for citations, record_hash, depth, lineage, SELF_CHECK projection, and adjacency. Replace overlapping witnessed fields oneOf branches with kind-discriminated object branches or a nonexclusive field schema so valid SOURCE_VALUE and ANIMAL_VALUE rows validate exactly once in DREAM and SELF_CHECK. Verify under P1CB03 without adding a semantic verifier.

disagreements.issue: Whether required SOURCE_VALUE/ANIMAL_VALUE queries validate and whether each candidate roster is prospectively bound to the concrete compiler cue it scores.

positions.position: Kind plus view_id plus missing_index and the existing query schemas are sufficient to register every legal atomic recognition case.
Identical SOURCE_VALUE/ANIMAL_VALUE query branches fail oneOf, while a coarse roster key cannot identify semantic_hash, cue bytes, or a concrete view instance and permits wrong-roster substitution.

resolution.rationale: Both defects are structural and blocking. The protocol promises a roster for every view instance, whose registered identity already includes semantic_hash, view_id, and missing_index; the schema must carry that identity and exact cue binding.
resolution.selected_position: Use kind-discriminated atomic queries and one roster per concrete semantic_hash/view_id/missing_index cue instance.
resolution.required_change: Successor requirement: refactor THINK0, THINK1, scratch, and previous_read schemas so every legal one-null query/result validates exactly one kind branch; extend each candidate roster with semantic_hash, view_id, missing_index, cue_sha256, and cue-token hash, enforce exactly one roster for every realized view instance, and reject missing, duplicate, swapped, wrong-semantic, wrong-view, or reused roster bindings. P1CB04 must include every positive branch and all named negative vectors.

disagreements.issue: Whether the sole public projector can legally construct all six registered DEV lives.

positions.position: DEV and heldout use only public_projection_contract.json, including seed-1 lives with 49 episodes and proof references through M000046.

positions.actor: public projection contract and event schemas
positions.position: The sole mapper instantiates seed 5, requires exactly 46 events, and caps E/M identities at index 45.

resolution.rationale: No implementation can satisfy both positions, so the three-arm DEV gate is currently unconstructible. A seed-generic DEV branch preserves the registered fixtures and heldout vectors with less scientific change than replacing the lives.
resolution.selected_position: Add an exact seed-generic DEV projection branch while leaving the seed-5 heldout projection byte-identical.
resolution.required_change: Successor requirement: define a deterministic DEV branch of the sole public projector that instantiates each registered seed/bit, uses its actual episode count, assigns contiguous E/M aliases through the actual last index, and extends closed identity schemas through index 48; bind exact seed-0/1/2 per-life projection and vocabulary hashes and prove all existing seed-5 46-event vectors remain byte-identical. P1CB05 must reject any fixture-local mapper, count truncation, alias gap, or heldout drift.

disagreements.issue: Whether P1CB06 supports necessity of recurrent construction as a whole or only verifies the schedule and return-loop treatment.

positions.position: M0 versus OWN/DIST can be described as a recurrence-removal comparison for the constructor.
All branches retain the full 84-slot prefix; only the sixteen return slots differ, so P1CB06 is an executability/matching invariant and causal credit is limited to goal-routed return feedback.

resolution.rationale: The second position follows directly from the registered arms. No new prefix ablation is required for the narrow canary, but broader recurrence claims are unsupported.
resolution.selected_position: Retain P1CB06 as an executability and branch-matching invariant and limit causal language to the sixteen-slot return loop.
resolution.required_change: Successor requirement: describe M0/OWN/DIST only as a return-recurrence intervention after a common recurrent prefix; P1CB06 must not be cited as evidence that prefix recurrence, repeated dreaming as a whole, or graph growth was necessary, and P1CB10 must reject those inferences.

disagreements.issue: Whether infeasible matched sham is invalid precondition or a valid Stage-T scientific/control-identifiability failure, and what can be reported from the five executed arms.

positions.position: Sham infeasibility is an invalid precondition.

positions.actor: change, resolution, experiment, operation, intervention, and review contracts
positions.position: SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE is VALID_STAGE_FAILURE; five arms execute, T-SHAM has zero attempts, and full causal-use pass is impossible.
The five-arm packet may be reported descriptively but cannot substitute for the missing sham control or support a weakened causal-use conclusion.

resolution.rationale: The second and third positions preserve the architecture's intended scientific-negative classification and prospectivity. The lone acceptance-registry clause is inconsistent with the dominant exact normative evidence and must be repaired in a successor rather than silently ignored.
resolution.selected_position: Classify sham infeasibility as VALID_STAGE_FAILURE/SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE, execute the other five arms, record exact zero-attempt T-SHAM rows, and forbid any causal-use pass or weakened replacement claim.
resolution.required_change: Successor requirement: make change, resolution, experiment, operation, intervention, stage-review, authority, ledger, acceptance-registry, and packet wording byte-consistent with VALID_STAGE_FAILURE/SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE; P1CB07 must assert five-arm continuation, exact T-SHAM zero-attempt rows, terminal packet/token routing, and impossibility of full or weakened causal credit.

disagreements.issue: Whether the conditional LoRA stage establishes a substrate-equivalent text-memory replacement or only selected closed candidate recognition.

positions.position: Shared semantic sources and a common thinker-facing projection permit text-memory equivalence or preserved-memory language.

The host pre-resolves zero/one/multiple values, supplies an answer-bearing union roster, tests 48 selected cases with four errors allowed, and has no matched text/RAG comparison; only immediate candidate-constrained recognition is supported.

resolution.rationale: A common output interface is an information firewall, not statistical or cognitive substrate equivalence. The proposal's narrow registered claim is the maximum defensible one.
resolution.selected_position: Retain only immediate candidate-constrained recognition language for the two registered adapters and paths.
resolution.required_change: Successor requirement: P1CB08 and every terminal must disclose host pre-resolution, the shared answer roster, 44/48 per-life threshold, selected cue set, and own/donor paths; P1CB10 must reject text equivalence, retrieval-free or open recall, whole-corpus preservation, durability, capacity, scale, RAG/raw-context comparison, and superiority language.

disagreements.issue: Whether operation_contract and stage_review_contract define one total state/reason encoding for every registered opportunity.

positions.position: Missing abstraction, sham infeasibility, and fidelity failure use NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FAILURE, while post-terminal cases use detailed PRIOR_* reasons.
NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FAILURE is absent; the same stage failures use NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL and a different closed reason vocabulary.

resolution.rationale: The same opportunity cannot validate against both closed tables, so P1CB09's exactly-one-effect invariant is impossible. A successor may choose either coherent naming system, but not a mixture; using an explicit STAGE_FAILURE state best distinguishes prospectively undispatched stage-gate cases from trace-local post-terminal cases.
resolution.selected_position: Adopt one shared ledger schema with NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FAILURE for missing abstraction, sham infeasibility, and fidelity failure, and reserve NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL for trace-local terminals.
resolution.required_change: Successor requirement: publish one referenced ledger-row schema and exhaustive condition-to-state-to-reason table used byte-identically by operation, intervention, review, authority, acceptance, and packet contracts. Bind vectors for duplicate, precondition, unauthorized stage, COMMIT, REQUEST_RETURN, DEFER, budget exhaustion, model failure, infrastructure invalidity, missing abstraction, sham infeasibility, fidelity failure, and post-stage termination. P1CB09 must reject every unmapped, multiply mapped, or cross-contract-different row.

disagreements.issue: Whether v1c can imply action improvement, general usefulness, or proved reviewer independence beyond its one-pair scaffolded operational evidence.

positions.position: A green end-to-end organism and two review approvals could be described as useful experiential memory improving action with independently validated governance.

The environment actions are generator-supplied, the model commits only a final token, alternatives are not empirically compared, and identity receipts attest workflow separation only; both positive and negative claims must remain one-pair scaffolded diagnostics.

resolution.rationale: The second position matches the frozen Paper-1 evidence boundary and the review contract's own attestation disclaimer. Governance conformance cannot broaden scientific evidence.
resolution.selected_position: Keep the current narrow engineering-ceiling claim and state that review separation is platform-attested only.
resolution.required_change: Successor requirement: P1CB10 must include rejecting fixtures for recurrence-as-a-whole, generic construction, generalization, action improvement, online learning, continued improvement, open recall, whole-corpus storage, durability, capacity, scale, superiority, text/LoRA equivalence, reviewer-independence proof, and Paper-1-headline language, plus negative-result overlocalization. Every terminal must say that public actions were environment-generated and reviewer separation was platform-attested, not proved.
